name: Agent Passport System
description: Agent Passport System trust verification provider for OpenClaw. Reference implementation of Agent Trust Verification Provider Pattern v0.1. Gates skill installs against the APS public trust registry, gates high-risk tool calls behind explicit approval, and exposes APS primitives (grade lookup, delegation verification, message signing) via OpenClaw gateway RPC.

provider.description: Provider name. Always 'aps' for this plugin.

verifier.description: Public APS trust profile API base URL.

jwks.description: APS gateway JWKS endpoint for envelope signature verification.

passportPath.description: Local APS passport file path. Used by aps.signMessage RPC for outbound message signing. If absent, signing methods are unavailable but install/tool gates still work.

warnBelow.description: Surface a warning finding when author APS grade is below this value.

blockBelow.description: Block install when author APS grade is below this value. null disables blocking.

highRiskTools.description: Tool names treated as high-risk. Default: bash, exec, fetch.
